ACTION REQUIRED BY REPOSITORY OWNER

Add the encrypted GitHub Actions repository secret GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON.
The service-account email must have Full access to sc-domain:youraicoach.life.

Secure setup:
  bash tools/ai-marketing/bootstrap-gsc-secret.sh YOUR_GCP_PROJECT_ID

Detailed guide:
  .github/SEO_GSC_BOOTSTRAP.md

Do not paste the JSON key into source control, chat, issues, or workflow logs.
